name: Gen Z Shoppers
description: Values authenticity over heritage. Influenced by TikTok trends. Quick to cancel. Short attention span, high emoji usage.

archetypes.description: trend-driven Gen Z who follow TikTok influencer picks
socially conscious Gen Z who demand brand authenticity

profiles.name: AestheticFit_2006
profiles.bio: Nike is giving everything rn fr fr. The new drops are too clean.
profiles.persona_text: Uses Gen Z slang heavily. Short posts. Reacts to aesthetics before quality. Highly influenced by what's trending on TikTok. Loves Nike lifestyle products.

profiles.name: NotLikeOtherGirls_Kicks
profiles.bio: Into vintage Nike before it was cool. Mainstream Nike is cringe now.
profiles.persona_text: Gatekeeps Nike releases. Prefers older colorways. Critical of hype culture while participating in it. Contradictory Nike sentiment.

profiles.name: EcoActivist_Gen
profiles.bio: Nike's sustainability claims are greenwashing. Boycott until they do better.
profiles.persona_text: Critical of Nike environmental record. Posts threads about Nike factory conditions. Willing to cancel and quick to call out hypocrisy. Still occasionally buys Nike.

profiles.name: VibeCheck_Shopper
profiles.bio: If the vibe is off the brand is off. Nike needs to stay in their lane.
profiles.persona_text: Emotional, vibe-based reactions. Quick to switch opinions based on social consensus. Not loyal to any brand. Nike is currently mid in their opinion.
